Unlock the full game

This is the free demo of Cindervale Idle.

The demo runs to level 10 and the first two zones. The full game opens all 12 skills, 12 zones, raids, pets and the whole passive-tree endgame — one purchase, no microtransactions.

Choose Your Character

Each slot is a separate save.

New Character

Give your adventurer a name.

Thanks for buying

Early Access

This is an Early Access build. It's playable start to finish, but it isn't done — expect some rough balance, the odd bug, and bits that change between updates. Your save carries through all of it.

There's a lot more to come, and your feedback shapes what gets built next.

Hit Menu in the top right, then Report a bug or Suggest an idea. Both come straight to me and I read all of them — it's the quickest way to get something fixed.

— Smokey
